item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud thugs rje'i bcud las yi dam glu ru drag po'i mchod bskang gter gyi ga'u bdud rtsi 'khyil ba
item.coloph: gar gyi dbang phyug gi mchod bskang (skong)gter gyi ga'u bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gros snyigs ma'i kho bo bdag gi snyan du brgyud bzhin du/ skal ldan gshen gyi bskul ngor phyi rabs don du/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug mngon par dga' ba'i rtse ru bkod pa sarba mang+ga ga lam//
